construction.rule: Base construction records receiver class/package, base version, entrypoint, completion, and initial reserved-surface integrity without virtual dispatch through the descendant.

reserved_surface.rule: All non-private AlchemyObject instance methods except INIT are reserved; VERSION and SCHEMA are class facts and intentionally remain available as descendant business instance-message names.
reserved_surface.reason: Downstream shadowing must not silently replace universal evidence, security, lifecycle, telemetry, requirement, contract or instrumentation behavior while legitimate business version()/schema() methods remain possible.

checkpoint.rule: A checkpoint binds object identity, target class, base version, construction fingerprint and current reserved-surface fingerprint. Later differences are reported as explicit drift. A checkpoint is evidence, not execution authority.

reserved_surface_rule: Descendants may override INIT and may define business VERSION/SCHEMA. Other non-private AlchemyObject surface names are reserved; descendants should call self~init:super(...) so construction enters the non-virtual Alchemy base core.
